tier_reason: B stands; correctness bug in the read loop documented (published small-file numbers unaffected).

corrections.caveats: Enricher (code reading): src/File.cpp's read loop never advances its pointer, so a short read (files over 2,147,479,552 bytes, FUSE or NFS) overwrites the buffer start and leaves the tail unread; EINTR not retried. README says gcc 4.8+ but configure.ac requires C++20; byte-only matching.

tier_reason: C stands; unbounded bracket nesting (possible stack out-of-bounds write) and a warm-row assert that does not check lexer output documented.

corrections.caveats: Enricher (code reading, not reproduced): no bracket-nesting bound, unlike upstream cjs-module-lexer's STACK_DEPTH 2048 check, so more than 2048 nested ( or { writes past the stack-allocated CJSLexer arrays. The import-cjs.js warm assert compares Object.keys(result.default), which is independent of the lexer output, so the warm row does not verify correctness.
